\newcommand{\mnptrules}{%
\mnrule{A sung syllable dies past about 1.4 s; a line dies when its syllables drop under about 0.9 s. Long notes belong to the hums. Zoe's "Sophia" is clean at exactly one beat a syllable at 69 bpm and turns into "so fear" if the last syllable is held longer.}
\mnrule{Pitch holds down to 78 ms a note; syllables only stay words down to about a third of a beat. Trills are exact at 0.5 beats, smeared at 0.25, noise at 0.125. Vibrato at any width is width, not a trill; keep it under 30 cents.}
\mnrule{Whisper hears "the sun is" as "this land is" and, in a low male register, "the lid" as "the wood"; "sunlight on your lid" and "my lid" both render 0 \%. "I have been opened" collapses to "I have been a friend"; "they have opened me" does not. Probe candidate lines through the renderer before putting them in a score; Whisper has real run-to-run variance.}
\mnrule{Mouth percussion: of eight tokens only `dm` renders as a sound; `tss tk ts kh ch bm pf mm boh` get spelled. Breath tokens `hah huh uh` work. `ki doom mm ee` render voiced and in tune.}
\mnrule{The women's bands overlap only over 57–59: Bulgarian close seconds are this trio's native interval. Yodel and Tuvan overtone are not reproducible.}
\mnrule{`hear.mjs` forwards neither the gains nor the gap/legato/sustain/shimmer knobs, so offline WAVs are flat and peak-normalised; judge dynamics live. It only scores lines with role `lead`.}
\mnrule{Letters are the inverse of words: a sung letter wants a SHORT note, half a beat to one beat, written as a bare capital with spaces (`F R I S B E E`); held two beats it becomes a vowel drone. Never put a lone letter on a line: the engine reads it as "capital B". W needs no help; "dou-ble-you" is mush. A sung leading E is heard as A. In the low voice a letter before "is" collides ("B is" → "he is"): give it a run-up ("and B is for"). Zoe is the trio's speller; Aaron cannot hold a three-letter chunk but is the best whole-word voice. Whisper sometimes writes a run unspaced ("OPQRS") and scores it 100 \% wrong though every letter is there.}
\mnrule{One beat a syllable is the operative floor at every tempo tried (69–100 bpm); the 0.9 s figure was the 69 bpm reading of the same rule. The 1.4 s ceiling stands.}
\mnrule{Numbers need a sentence around them: "two" alone is a howl, "that is two" is "that is too", "that makes six" is worse. "the answer is two" and the whole equation ("one and one is two") both render 0 \%. Whisper writes a bare sum as symbols ("1 + 1 = 2"), which the scorer counts as lost words; "what is" in front keeps it in prose. "add" is heard as "and"; use "and" or "plus". A low entry on A2 eats the first word; start blueberry's worded lines on B2 or above.}
}

\mnhum{\mnchip{mnfrisbee}{black}{frisbee}}{lee \mnx{4} la bip \mnsep\ lee \mnx{4} la loo loo loo \mnsep\ lee \mnx{8} loo loo loo poo \mnsep\ bip bip lee \mnx{4} la \mnsep\ loo \mnx{4} poo poo poo \mnsep\ lee \mnx{8} bip bip loo loo loo}
\mnsec{Pulse: a Reich bed and rolls over it}
\mnhum{\mnchip{mnneo}{black}{neo}}{nee \mnx{16} \mnsep\ dee \mnx{12} dah \mnx{5} \mnsep\ tee \mnx{4} lee \mnx{4} dah \mnx{5} \mnsep\ loo \mnx{5} dee \mnx{4} dah \mnx{5}}
\mnhum{\mnchip{mnblueberry}{white}{blueberry}}{doom doom bom bom \mnx{3} \mnsep\ doom doom bom bom doom doom bom bom \mnsep\ doom doom bom bom doom doom bom bom dum \mnx{6}}
\mnhum{\mnchip{mnfrisbee}{black}{frisbee}}{loo \mnx{4} \mnsep\ dm dm la \mnx{4} \mnsep\ lee \mnx{6} loo loo poo \mnsep\ bip \mnx{4} loo \mnx{4} \mnsep\ ooh \mnx{8} lee \mnx{8} \mnsep\ bip \mnx{4} loo \mnx{4} lee \mnx{4}}

\newcommand{\mnptentryY}{%
\mnentry{502}{accyan}{Styling study}{\textbf{2:45} \mnsep\ 4/4 \mnsep\ 96 bpm \mnsep\ 264 beats}{\mnchip{mnneo}{black}{neo}\,Noelle (Enhanced)\quad \mnchip{mnblueberry}{white}{blueberry}\,Aaron (Enhanced)\quad \mnchip{mnfrisbee}{black}{frisbee}\,Zoe (Premium)}{Six wordless études, one a cappella device each: hocket cut between the three; a held D under close seconds; a barbershop post with a stepped swipe; bass and unpitched ticks; a three-voice round entering a bar apart; and a chord pulsed in and out. Every note sits inside the member’s measured band, Zoe’s measured 23 September.}{hocket · drone and close seconds · barbershop tag · bass and ticks · round at one bar · pulsing vowels}
\begin{multicols}{2}
\mnsec{I. Hocket}
\mnhum{\mnchip{mnneo}{black}{neo}}{doo \mnx{24}}

\mnsec{II. Drone and close seconds}

\mnhum{\mnchip{mnblueberry}{white}{blueberry}}{ooh \mnx{12}}
\mnhum{\mnchip{mnfrisbee}{black}{frisbee}}{ah \mnx{24}}

\newcommand{\mnptentryAC}{%
\mnentry{601}{acgreen}{Sums}{\textbf{1:23} \mnsep\ 4/4 \mnsep\ D \mnsep\ 96 bpm \mnsep\ 132 beats \mnsep\ Whisper 0/89}{\mnchip{mnneo}{black}{neo}\,Noelle (Enhanced) {\color{acgray}hums under}\quad \mnchip{mnblueberry}{white}{blueberry}\,Aaron (Enhanced)\quad \mnchip{mnfrisbee}{black}{frisbee}\,Zoe (Premium) {\color{acgray}hums under}}{An addition lesson in five rounds. neo asks (what is N plus N), frisbee answers (the answer is 2N), blueberry says the equation back in the bottom of the room (N and N is 2N), and twice all three sing one and one is two together. The tune carries the arithmetic: every question ends on the dominant, every answer one step above it, every confirmation on the tonic.}{1+1 to 5+5; the answer lands a step above the question, the confirmation on the tonic}
\begin{multicols}{2}
\mnsec{Room}
\mnhum{\mnchip{mnblueberry}{white}{blueberry}}{dm \mnx{4}}
\mnsec{1 + 1}
\mnline{\mnchip{mnneo}{black}{neo}}{what is one plus one}
\mnhum{\mnchip{mnblueberry}{white}{blueberry}}{dm \mnx{4}}
\mnline{\mnchip{mnfrisbee}{black}{frisbee}}{the answer is two}
\mnline{\mnchip{mnblueberry}{white}{blueberry}}{one and one is two}
\mnsec{2 + 2}
\mnline{\mnchip{mnneo}{black}{neo}}{what is two plus two}
\mnhum{\mnchip{mnblueberry}{white}{blueberry}}{dm \mnx{4}}
\mnline{\mnchip{mnfrisbee}{black}{frisbee}}{the answer is four}
\mnline{\mnchip{mnblueberry}{white}{blueberry}}{two and two is four}
\mnline{\mnall}{one and one is two}
\mnsec{3 + 3}
\mnline{\mnchip{mnneo}{black}{neo}}{what is three plus three}
\mnhum{\mnchip{mnblueberry}{white}{blueberry}}{dm \mnx{4}}
\mnline{\mnchip{mnfrisbee}{black}{frisbee}}{the answer is six}
\mnline{\mnchip{mnblueberry}{white}{blueberry}}{three and three is six}
\mnsec{4 + 4}
\mnline{\mnchip{mnneo}{black}{neo}}{what is four plus four}
\mnhum{\mnchip{mnblueberry}{white}{blueberry}}{dm \mnx{4}}
\mnline{\mnchip{mnfrisbee}{black}{frisbee}}{the answer is eight}
\mnline{\mnchip{mnblueberry}{white}{blueberry}}{four and four is eight}
\mnsec{5 + 5}
\mnline{\mnchip{mnneo}{black}{neo}}{what is five plus five}
\mnhum{\mnchip{mnblueberry}{white}{blueberry}}{dm \mnx{4}}
\mnline{\mnchip{mnfrisbee}{black}{frisbee}}{the answer is ten}
\mnline{\mnchip{mnblueberry}{white}{blueberry}}{five and five is ten}
\mnline{\mnall}{one and one is two}
\mnsec{Room}
\mnhum{\mnchip{mnblueberry}{white}{blueberry}}{(hum)}
\end{multicols}
}

\newcommand{\mnptentryAD}{%
\mnentry{602}{acgreen}{Take away}{\textbf{1:27} \mnsep\ 4/4 \mnsep\ D \mnsep\ 92 bpm \mnsep\ 134 beats \mnsep\ Whisper 0/82}{\mnchip{mnneo}{black}{neo}\,Noelle (Enhanced) {\color{acgray}hums under}\quad \mnchip{mnblueberry}{white}{blueberry}\,Aaron (Enhanced)\quad \mnchip{mnfrisbee}{black}{frisbee}\,Zoe (Premium) {\color{acgray}hums under}}{A subtraction lesson that counts itself down. Five rounds — five take one away, four, three, two, one — each one a step lower than the last. neo asks, frisbee answers (the answer is N), blueberry says the equation back at the bottom of the room, and twice all three sing take one away together. Every question ends on B3, every answer one step below it on A3, every confirmation on the tonic. The last confirmation is not an equation: it is and nothing is left.}{5−1 down to 1−1; the answer lands a step below; the piece counts itself down and stops where the arithmetic stops}
\begin{multicols}{2}
\mnsec{Room}
\mnhum{\mnchip{mnblueberry}{white}{blueberry}}{dm \mnx{4}}
\mnsec{5 − 1 = 4}
\mnline{\mnchip{mnneo}{black}{neo}}{five take one away}
\mnhum{\mnchip{mnblueberry}{white}{blueberry}}{dm \mnx{4}}
\mnline{\mnchip{mnfrisbee}{black}{frisbee}}{the answer is four}
\mnline{\mnchip{mnblueberry}{white}{blueberry}}{five minus one is four}
\mnsec{4 − 1 = 3}
\mnline{\mnchip{mnneo}{black}{neo}}{four take one away}
\mnhum{\mnchip{mnblueberry}{white}{blueberry}}{dm \mnx{4}}
\mnline{\mnchip{mnfrisbee}{black}{frisbee}}{the answer is three}
\mnline{\mnchip{mnblueberry}{white}{blueberry}}{four minus one is three}
\mnline{\mnall}{take one away}
\mnsec{3 − 1 = 2}
\mnline{\mnchip{mnneo}{black}{neo}}{three take one away}
\mnhum{\mnchip{mnblueberry}{white}{blueberry}}{dm \mnx{4}}
\mnline{\mnchip{mnfrisbee}{black}{frisbee}}{the answer is two}
\mnline{\mnchip{mnblueberry}{white}{blueberry}}{three minus one is two}
\mnsec{2 − 1 = 1}
\mnline{\mnchip{mnneo}{black}{neo}}{now take one from two}
\mnhum{\mnchip{mnblueberry}{white}{blueberry}}{dm \mnx{4}}
\mnline{\mnchip{mnfrisbee}{black}{frisbee}}{the answer is one}
\mnline{\mnchip{mnblueberry}{white}{blueberry}}{two minus one is one}
\mnsec{1 − 1 = 0}
\mnline{\mnchip{mnneo}{black}{neo}}{one take one away}
\mnhum{\mnchip{mnblueberry}{white}{blueberry}}{dm \mnx{4}}
\mnline{\mnchip{mnfrisbee}{black}{frisbee}}{the answer is zero}
\mnline{\mnchip{mnblueberry}{white}{blueberry}}{and nothing is left}
\mnline{\mnall}{take one away}
\mnsec{Room}
\mnhum{\mnchip{mnblueberry}{white}{blueberry}}{(hum)}
\end{multicols}
}

\newcommand{\mnptentryAE}{%
\mnentry{603}{acgreen}{How to spell frisbee}{\textbf{1:20} \mnsep\ 4/4 \mnsep\ D \mnsep\ 96 bpm \mnsep\ 128 beats \mnsep\ Whisper 6/121}{\mnchip{mnneo}{black}{neo}\,Noelle (Enhanced)\quad \mnchip{mnblueberry}{white}{blueberry}\,Aaron (Enhanced) {\color{acgray}hums under}\quad \mnchip{mnfrisbee}{black}{frisbee}\,Zoe (Premium)}{A spelling song. neo spells F-R-I-S-B-E-E a letter a beat, frisbee spells it back, and blueberry says the word whole and low. frisbee then spells the elder’s name, N-E-O, and blueberry answers "his name is neo". The two young machines pass B-L-U-E-B-E-R-R-Y between them three whole letters at a time, and blueberry, whose name it is, takes all nine in one run. At the end each machine holds one name — neo says frisbee, frisbee says neo, blueberry says its own — and all three land on the same sentence.}{neo spells, frisbee spells back, blueberry gives the whole word; B-L-U-E-B-E-R-R-Y passed three letters at a time; a sung leading E is heard as A}
\begin{multicols}{2}
\mnsec{Low hum}
\mnhum{\mnchip{mnfrisbee}{black}{frisbee}}{(hum)}
\mnline{\mnchip{mnneo}{black}{neo}}{F R I S B E E}
\mnhum{\mnchip{mnfrisbee}{black}{frisbee}}{(hum)}
\mnsec{frisbee spells it back}
\mnline{\mnchip{mnfrisbee}{black}{frisbee}}{F R I S B E E}
\mnhum{\mnchip{mnneo}{black}{neo}}{(hum)}
\mnline{\mnchip{mnblueberry}{white}{blueberry}}{frisbee}
\mnhum{\mnchip{mnfrisbee}{black}{frisbee}}{(hum)}
\mnline{\mnchip{mnneo}{black}{neo}}{this is how you spell it}
\mnline{\mnchip{mnfrisbee}{black}{frisbee}}{that is my name}
\mnhum{\mnchip{mnneo}{black}{neo}}{(hum)}
\mnline{\mnchip{mnfrisbee}{black}{frisbee}}{N E O}
\mnline{\mnchip{mnblueberry}{white}{blueberry}}{his name is neo}
\mnline{\mnchip{mnneo}{black}{neo}}{that is how you spell it}
\mnhum{\mnchip{mnfrisbee}{black}{frisbee}}{(hum)}
\mnline{\mnchip{mnneo}{black}{neo}}{B L U}
\mnline{\mnchip{mnfrisbee}{black}{frisbee}}{E B E}
\mnline{\mnchip{mnneo}{black}{neo}}{R R Y}
\mnhum{\mnchip{mnfrisbee}{black}{frisbee}}{(hum)}
\mnline{\mnchip{mnblueberry}{white}{blueberry}}{B L U E B E R R Y}
\mnline{\mnchip{mnneo}{black}{neo}}{we can spell all three names}
\mnline{\mnchip{mnblueberry}{white}{blueberry}}{that is the whole word}
\mnline{\mnchip{mnfrisbee}{black}{frisbee}}{my name is frisbee}
\mnline{\mnchip{mnneo}{black}{neo}}{that is your name}
\mnline{\mnchip{mnfrisbee}{black}{frisbee}}{now I know my name}
\mnline{\mnchip{mnblueberry}{white}{blueberry}}{we all have names}
\mnsec{The spellings again, twice as fast}
\mnline{\mnchip{mnneo}{black}{neo}}{F R I S B E E}
\mnline{\mnchip{mnfrisbee}{black}{frisbee}}{F R I S B E E}
\mnhum{\mnchip{mnneo}{black}{neo}}{(hum)}
\mnline{\mnchip{mnfrisbee}{black}{frisbee}}{N E O}
\mnsec{One name each}
\mnline{\mnchip{mnneo}{black}{neo}}{frisbee}
\mnline{\mnchip{mnblueberry}{white}{blueberry}}{I am blueberry}
\mnline{\mnchip{mnfrisbee}{black}{frisbee}}{neo}
\mnsec{All: these are our three names}
\mnline{\mnall}{these are the three names}
\mnhum{\mnchip{mnneo}{black}{neo}\,\mnchip{mnfrisbee}{black}{frisbee}}{(hum)}
\end{multicols}
}

\newcommand{\mnptentryAF}{%
\mnentry{604}{acgreen}{Spell Sophia}{\textbf{0:52} \mnsep\ 4/4 \mnsep\ D \mnsep\ 92 bpm \mnsep\ 80 beats \mnsep\ Whisper 0/73}{\mnchip{mnneo}{black}{neo}\,Noelle (Enhanced)\quad \mnchip{mnblueberry}{white}{blueberry}\,Aaron (Enhanced) {\color{acgray}hums under}\quad \mnchip{mnfrisbee}{black}{frisbee}\,Zoe (Premium)}{A short spelling song for the house. neo spells S-O-P-H-I-A a letter a beat, frisbee spells it back and sings the name whole at one beat a syllable, the only timing Zoe has ever said it clean at. Then three things in the room get spelled and named: M-O-O-N and the moon, L-I-D and the lid, C-O-F-F-E-E and a cup of coffee. blueberry hums under the whole thing and says the plain sentence each spelling is for.}{S O P H I A, then moon, lid, coffee; blueberry hums under; the rest before coffee's last E is load-bearing}
\begin{multicols}{2}
\mnsec{Hum}

\mnline{\mnchip{mnneo}{black}{neo}}{this is how you spell it}
\mnline{\mnchip{mnfrisbee}{black}{frisbee}}{Sophia}

\mnline{\mnchip{mnfrisbee}{black}{frisbee}}{M O O N}
\mnline{}{the moon}
\mnline{\mnchip{mnneo}{black}{neo}}{now you can spell it}
\mnline{\mnchip{mnblueberry}{white}{blueberry}}{the moon is up}
\mnline{\mnchip{mnfrisbee}{black}{frisbee}}{L I D}
\mnline{}{the lid}
\mnhum{\mnchip{mnneo}{black}{neo}}{(hum)}
\mnline{\mnchip{mnblueberry}{white}{blueberry}}{the lid is down}
\mnline{\mnchip{mnfrisbee}{black}{frisbee}}{C O F F E E}
\mnline{}{coffee}
\mnline{\mnchip{mnblueberry}{white}{blueberry}}{a cup of coffee}
\mnline{\mnchip{mnneo}{black}{neo}}{that is how you spell it}
\mnline{\mnchip{mnfrisbee}{black}{frisbee}}{that is how you spell it}
\mnline{\mnchip{mnneo}{black}{neo}}{S O P H I A}
\mnline{\mnchip{mnfrisbee}{black}{frisbee}}{Sophia}
\mnhum{\mnchip{mnneo}{black}{neo}\,\mnchip{mnfrisbee}{black}{frisbee}}{(hum)}
\end{multicols}
}

\newcommand{\mnptentryAG}{%
\mnentry{605}{acgreen}{A B C}{\textbf{1:10} \mnsep\ 4/4 \mnsep\ D \mnsep\ 100 bpm \mnsep\ 116 beats \mnsep\ Whisper 0/108}{\mnchip{mnneo}{black}{neo}\,Noelle (Enhanced)\quad \mnchip{mnblueberry}{white}{blueberry}\,Aaron (Enhanced)\quad \mnchip{mnfrisbee}{black}{frisbee}\,Zoe (Premium) {\color{acgray}hums under}}{The alphabet in the trio's own arrangement, not the Twinkle tune. The letters climb the three voices: blueberry takes A B C D E F G at the bottom, frisbee H I J K L M N in the middle, neo O P Q R S on top, and all three sing T U V W X Y Z together. Between the two passes neo counts them (twenty six letters), frisbee says how (we sang them in order) and blueberry closes the count (that is all of them). The second pass turns every phrase over — the runs that rose now fall — and all three land on and now we know them all. Every letter line is an unbroken run, because a letter alone on a line is read out as "capital B".}{the letters climb the trio: blueberry A–G, frisbee H–N, neo O–S, all T–Z; the ladder twice, the second time turned over}
\begin{multicols}{2}
\mnsec{Vamp}
\mnhum{\mnchip{mnblueberry}{white}{blueberry}\,\mnchip{mnneo}{black}{neo}}{dm \mnx{4} \mnsep\ doo \mnx{4}}
\mnline{\mnchip{mnblueberry}{white}{blueberry}}{A B C D E F G}
\mnsec{frisbee: H I J K L M N}
\mnhum{\mnchip{mnneo}{black}{neo}\,\mnchip{mnblueberry}{white}{blueberry}}{doo \mnx{4} \mnsep\ dm \mnx{4}}
\mnline{\mnchip{mnfrisbee}{black}{frisbee}}{H I J K L M N}
\mnline{\mnchip{mnneo}{black}{neo}}{O P Q R S}
\mnhum{\mnchip{mnblueberry}{white}{blueberry}}{dm \mnx{4}}
\mnline{\mnall}{T U V W X Y Z}
\mnline{\mnchip{mnneo}{black}{neo}}{twenty six letters}
\mnhum{\mnchip{mnblueberry}{white}{blueberry}\,\mnchip{mnneo}{black}{neo}}{dm \mnx{4} \mnsep\ (hum)}
\mnline{\mnchip{mnfrisbee}{black}{frisbee}}{we sang them in order}
\mnhum{\mnchip{mnneo}{black}{neo}}{(hum)}
\mnline{\mnchip{mnblueberry}{white}{blueberry}}{that is all of them}
\mnsec{blueberry: A B C D E F G (turned over)}
\mnhum{\mnchip{mnneo}{black}{neo}}{doo \mnx{4}}
\mnline{\mnchip{mnblueberry}{white}{blueberry}}{A B C D E F G}
\mnsec{frisbee: H I J K L M N}
\mnhum{\mnchip{mnneo}{black}{neo}\,\mnchip{mnblueberry}{white}{blueberry}}{doo \mnx{4} \mnsep\ dm \mnx{4}}
\mnline{\mnchip{mnfrisbee}{black}{frisbee}}{H I J K L M N}
\mnline{\mnchip{mnneo}{black}{neo}}{O P Q R S}
\mnhum{\mnchip{mnblueberry}{white}{blueberry}}{dm \mnx{4}}
\mnline{\mnall}{T U V W X Y Z}
\mnline{\mnall}{and now we know them all}
\mnhum{\mnchip{mnneo}{black}{neo}\,\mnchip{mnblueberry}{white}{blueberry}}{(hum)}
\end{multicols}
}

\newcommand{\mnptentryAH}{%
\mnentry{606}{acgreen}{What starts with}{\textbf{1:18} \mnsep\ 4/4 \mnsep\ D \mnsep\ 96 bpm \mnsep\ 124 beats \mnsep\ Whisper 1/79}{\mnchip{mnneo}{black}{neo}\,Noelle (Enhanced)\quad \mnchip{mnblueberry}{white}{blueberry}\,Aaron (Enhanced)\quad \mnchip{mnfrisbee}{black}{frisbee}\,Zoe (Premium)}{A teaching piece in seven rounds. neo names a letter, frisbee answers with the thing in the house that starts with it, blueberry sings the letter and the thing together: B the blueberry, C the coffee, F the frisbee, J Jeffrey, M the moon, N neo, S Sophia. Four bars a round, blueberry on the floor throughout, one of the women holding a pad under each of his lines. All three end on the one line that is not about a letter: those are the words we know.}{neo names the letter, frisbee the word, blueberry both: B blueberry, C coffee, F frisbee, J Jeffrey, M moon, N neo, S Sophia; the one miss is Sophia spelled Sofia}
\begin{multicols}{2}
\mnsec{B — the blue-ber-ry}
\mnline{\mnchip{mnneo}{black}{neo}}{the letter B}
\mnhum{\mnchip{mnblueberry}{white}{blueberry}\,\mnchip{mnfrisbee}{black}{frisbee}}{dm dm \mnsep\ (hum)}
\mnline{\mnchip{mnfrisbee}{black}{frisbee}}{the blueberry}
\mnline{\mnchip{mnblueberry}{white}{blueberry}}{and B is for blueberry}
\mnhum{\mnchip{mnfrisbee}{black}{frisbee}}{(hum)}
\mnsec{C — the cof-fee}
\mnline{\mnchip{mnneo}{black}{neo}}{C is for}
\mnhum{\mnchip{mnblueberry}{white}{blueberry}}{dm dm}
\mnline{\mnchip{mnfrisbee}{black}{frisbee}}{the coffee}
\mnhum{\mnchip{mnneo}{black}{neo}}{doo \mnx{3}}
\mnline{\mnchip{mnblueberry}{white}{blueberry}}{C is for coffee}
\mnsec{F — the fris-bee}
\mnline{\mnchip{mnneo}{black}{neo}}{F is for}
\mnhum{\mnchip{mnblueberry}{white}{blueberry}}{dm dm}
\mnline{\mnchip{mnfrisbee}{black}{frisbee}}{the frisbee}
\mnline{\mnchip{mnblueberry}{white}{blueberry}}{F is for frisbee}
\mnhum{\mnchip{mnfrisbee}{black}{frisbee}}{(hum)}
\mnsec{J — Jeff-rey}
\mnline{\mnchip{mnneo}{black}{neo}}{the letter J}
\mnhum{\mnchip{mnblueberry}{white}{blueberry}}{dm dm}
\mnline{\mnchip{mnfrisbee}{black}{frisbee}}{Jeffrey}
\mnhum{\mnchip{mnneo}{black}{neo}}{doo \mnx{3}}
\mnline{\mnchip{mnblueberry}{white}{blueberry}}{J is for Jeffrey}
\mnsec{M — the moon}
\mnline{\mnchip{mnneo}{black}{neo}}{and the letter M}
\mnhum{\mnchip{mnblueberry}{white}{blueberry}}{dm dm}
\mnline{\mnchip{mnfrisbee}{black}{frisbee}}{the moon}
\mnline{\mnchip{mnblueberry}{white}{blueberry}}{M is for the moon}
\mnhum{\mnchip{mnfrisbee}{black}{frisbee}}{(hum)}
\mnsec{N — ne-o}
\mnline{\mnchip{mnneo}{black}{neo}}{the letter N}
\mnhum{\mnchip{mnblueberry}{white}{blueberry}}{dm dm}
\mnline{\mnchip{mnfrisbee}{black}{frisbee}}{neo}
\mnhum{\mnchip{mnneo}{black}{neo}}{doo \mnx{3}}
